external_candidate_evidence.assessment: Useful future development and complementary-method material, but already unblinded, single-cohort and missing every PE acquisition stratum. It cannot be relabeled as an unopened Flashalign nonlinear audit.

admission.complete_failure_denominator: not evaluable: no admissible cases were declared or run
admission.pe_accuracy: blocked: no admissible PE cohort with independent geometry
admission.reverse_pe_accuracy: blocked and separate: no reverse-PE common-domain cohort
admission.fieldmap_accuracy: blocked and separate: no fieldmap-assisted cohort
admission.small_strain_anatomical_accuracy: blocked: no unopened multi-cohort audit with failure-tail strata
admission.model_class_fairness: protocol passed: PE superiority cannot be inferred from an affine-only comparator and acquisition-assisted strata cannot be pooled

supported: The acquired nonlinear court was specified before Flashalign execution.
The absence and inadmissibility of external inputs were audited reproducibly.
No missing lane was converted into a success or silently dropped.
unsupported: superiority over affine, HalfFlow, ANTs or another comparator

next_evidence_required: Implement and qualify an image-backed nonlinear projected-patch objective in the benchmark or production path.
Acquire and seal a subject-disjoint single-PE EPI-to-anatomy cohort with PE metadata, independent geometry and all four failure-tail cohorts.
Acquire and seal an untouched labeled or landmarked anatomical confirmation cohort; keep IBSR18 as development/comparison evidence.
Freeze matched-information PE and matched-geometry anatomical comparator adapters before opening evaluation evidence.
